tours.name: Mark a Payslip Batch as Paid

name_i18n.en_US: Mark a Payslip Batch as Paid

tours.description: Learn how to record that the salaries of a confirmed batch have been paid to the employees, so the batch and its payslips show as Paid.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to record that the salaries of a confirmed batch have been paid to the employees, so the batch and its payslips show as Paid.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: After the salaries have been transferred to the employees, the payment is recorded in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: After the salaries have been transferred to the employees, the payment is recorded in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu gives access to the payslips and to the batches that group them by pay period.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu gives access to the payslips and to the batches that group them by pay period.

steps.title: Batches
steps.description: This list shows every batch and its status. Only batches that are Done can be marked as paid.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every batch and its status. Only batches that are Done can be marked as paid.

steps.title: Open the batch
steps.content: Click the batch to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the batch to open it.

steps.description: Open the confirmed batch whose salaries have been paid. Its status bar shows Done.

description_i18n.en_US: Open the confirmed batch whose salaries have been paid. Its status bar shows Done.

steps.title: Mark as paid
steps.description: This records that the salaries were paid. The batch and all of its payslips move to Paid, which closes the pay period for payroll.

description_i18n.en_US: This records that the salaries were paid. The batch and all of its payslips move to Paid, which closes the pay period for payroll.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.content: Check that the batch status is now Paid, then click the batch name to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Check that the batch status is now Paid, then click the batch name to finish.

steps.description: The status bar shows the batch as Paid. Use this status in your month-end review to see which pay periods are fully completed.

description_i18n.en_US: The status bar shows the batch as Paid. Use this status in your month-end review to see which pay periods are fully completed.
